data.narrative:
Planted Solar is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $32M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Lonza, ticker LNZA) in the Climate & Energy sector, though direct same-stage and valuation-tier peers remain sparse.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable triangulation approach. Using total raised ($32M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $64M. A peer-median method could not be applied—while 9 same-sector companies exist in the dataset, none met the narrow filter criteria of same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier; attempting an all-sector median would introduce undue noise given the heterogeneity of climate technology development stages and capital intensity profiles.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $54M (low) to $74M (high), with a median point of $64M. This range reflects a ±15% band around the stage-progression output, accounting for estimation uncertainty given the reliance on a single quantitative method. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at Series A within frontier energy technology, the nascent market data for this cohort, and insufficient visibility into Planted Solar's specific technical and commercial milestones relative to the broader peer set.
